JAMIUL ALAM

About Me

I am a BBA Management student from Bangladesh with practical experience in warehouse operations, retail inventory management, seasonal agriculture, and crop management. Most of this experience has come from managing our family business operations and working extensively on our family farm.

Over time, I have developed a strong understanding of day-to-day operational work, including inventory tracking, stock rotation, handling goods, agricultural work, and maintaining safe and organized working environments. I am comfortable working in physically demanding and fast-paced environments and understand the importance of following safety procedures and completing tasks responsibly.

Alongside my practical experience, I have completed 8 professional, internationally recognized certificate courses covering Workplace Health & Safety (OHS), Manual Handling, Logistics & Procurement Management (Mercy Corps), Farm Machinery & Storage (FAO), Sustainable Food Systems (FAO), Food Safety & Hygiene (HACCP), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001:2015).

I am comfortable with physically demanding work and can safely lift and handle loads of up to 30 kg (66 lbs). I can adapt quickly to new tasks and working procedures, work effectively as part of a multicultural team, and follow workplace safety and quality requirements carefully.

My practical background has given me exposure to different types of work, from managing stock and goods in storage facilities to agricultural work, farm machinery, and maintaining quality standards in daily operations. I am particularly interested in opportunities where I can use this combination of practical experience, training, and willingness to learn.

Currently, I am looking for relocation opportunities in Europe in warehouse and logistics, and agriculture, particularly positions that offer visa sponsorship. I am ready to relocate and would be interested in connecting directly with prospective employers or licensed recruitment agencies to discuss suitable opportunities.
